notes.title: New version of demo (0.1.40) - More UI
notes.content:
A lot of the changes in the new demo version are not visible, but hopefully the grabbing of objects is now even more reliable. 

Gameplay:
- The gun tower gets extra accuracy when receiving secondary power (Yellow). This used to be damage over time, but I doubt any player could see the effect. This is a better match because high (long range) gun tower stacks resulted in more missed projectiles, making them only good against groups of enemies. Now with the accuracy boost the higher gun towers remain deadly to single enemies. 

Visual updates:
- Terrain lighting has been changed to give more light on the shadow side of terrain.
- New VFX showing which towers are connected

UI :
- Resource color has been changed to Blue for primary and Yellow for secondary. This now matches the colors of the basic towers supplying this power. And it matches the UI elements (hover tower/resource node/locked shop items)
- In the staging area there are UI-elements of every tower and building on the table. Grabbing these will show some basic info about the object. Like what effect adding primary or secondary power has on them, and the amount of power they can provide. 

Other :
- VDXR should now also just work. (this was already in a hotfix, but I did not put it in an announcement)

notes.title: Terrain shows you when you are under attack!! New demo version v0.1.31
notes.content:
A new version of the DEMO is now live on steam. The major change is that the terrain will now show
- tower range, radar range and combined vision range
- radar spawned, orange ring waves from enemy units
- red ring waves when your units are damaged

Never be surprised when you have suddenly lost your base, now you will be notified in time to stop it! 
I am really hoping this makes the game easier to play. Not knowing where the enemies were coming from, and losing units without even knowing about it was a big enemy of enjoyment. 

-The holotable also got a GPU performance uplift. 
-A bug the could lock a player in the AdvTutorial "Build a miner far away from the base" step has been fixed. 
- The second mission (desert) received a lot more extra units to help the player ease into the game. 

The 3rd mission is still very hard. I think this has to stay, since the real game will offer challenging missions to players. But in the real game this level of difficulty will only be at the final missions. 

Happy steam RTS fest next week, to everyone that loves this genre. 

Arnold

notes.title: Demo v0.1.30 - Simplify tutorial & blink tower stack
notes.content:
For most players the current update will be a bit 'meh', most of the changes are related to simplifying the first tutorial and missions. Until the advanced tutorial it will not be possible to use the scaling and rotating of the terrain. Snap turn on the joystick is still available, for players that are not able to turn around. 
This change automatically cuts the first tutorial in half, and hopefully will give new players a way to get into the real game a lot quicker. 

- Terrain offset change has been reverted to the 'two hand below terrain' movement system. This makes it much harder to accidentally move the terrain out of reach.  
- It is now possible to use the singlehanded movement system while holding something in your other hand. This is a big change to the gameplay options, but I think its not overpowered. 
- Losing an object from your grip without releasing the trigger, cannot directly transition to a movement input. So you first need to release your grip to 're-grab' the terrain or air.
- When a object is held, but is lost from the hand. The hand will not be used for movement until the grip is first released.
- When holding a tower block that is connected to other tower blocks, the entire affected collection is highlighted. 
- When taking damage your towers and buildings will blink. 

For the future I am afraid the terrain shader will need a big kick. Since its using a 3rd party shader currently there are some limits of what I can do with it. Both in adding features and in GPU performance. For the Quest 3 build I've already made a high performance version, but it came at a big cost to the visual  presentation.

notes.title: Demo update - Advanced buildings and resources tutorial - v0.1.28
notes.content:
At then end of the tutorial about resource gathering a section has been added about the secondary resource and how to mine it. The goes through all the steps:

- Unlocking extra build options by powering a factory with tower blocks.
- Gathering secondary resources using only primary resource structures. 
- Building at a distance from the base with a builder tower.
- Building Advanced Factory, which can build Missile towers.
- Using the missile towers to boost the mining of secondary resource. 

There is always a choice to be made in how you use your towers. Upgrading buildings, Mining resources, exploring or combat.

notes.title: Demo v1.10 : New movement mechanic !!
notes.content:
The movement mechanic has been changed to a 'Grab air with two hands -> Scale/Rotate/Translate' movement mechanic. The teleport option can still be used as a backup or supplement.
In the hub-area/menu level the movement mechanic is still the same, but I'll probably replace that too in the future.

With this new movement mechanic there are a lot of new exploits in the game. I'll just accept this for now until I get more feedback on the new movement mechanic. Limiting the freedom of the player did not feel fun, so enjoy being overly overpowered for a few weeks :-). 

The choice for a new mechanic was between. 'Grab air' and 'teleport grenades'. This one was chosen because the overview when zooming out really gives the RTS feeling that was missing so far. 
Teleport grenades were an option because throwing is a core game feature. It would also allow the enemy to destroy the grenade before the player would teleport, resulting in being more confined to the area under your control. 

Known issue:
- the known terrain seems to be taken from the last vision of the previous mission.

notes.title: next demo build delayed
notes.content:
Its been some time since the last new version was made available. This is caused by two things. The first one is that I've been working on the new trailer (which is currently in use). The second reason is that the current version of Unity has a bug that does not allow multiple missions to be played, so the game will crash as soon as you start a second mission. 

I expect the bug to be fixed in the next release, so I would rather wait for this than install an older version.    Normally I only upgrade when there is a feature that I need in the newer version. In this case I needed radars to be able to have different ranges, and the newest version did this automatically. 

The next demo version will feature 
- Opaque player avatar (Torso, Arms, Hands, Head)

- Radar range indicator shown when you don't have vision there.
- maybe some streaming settings I used to create the trailer. Currently the UI is not clear, but it does function if you know how... so maybe I'll disable it until its more finished

One of the streaming features is 3D recording in SBS mode, allowing viewers a 3D view of the battlefield. As seen in this video.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3iy60K-ELJo

notes.content:
On some devices the start of the tutorial would 'hang' restarting the dialog a lot of times before proceeding. Followed by bought buildings not being build in the tutorial. This update should fix this issue.
Sorry to everyone affected, I test every build but not on all headsets. 

Other changes in this update

- CPU performance improvement : Physics settings in 'Menu level' have been reduced to save some CPU performance. Made possible by reducing the amount of sections in the wire. 

- Physics : Tower block interaction in 'Menu level' (stack in cryopod) should now be better.

notes.content:
Just uploaded a new version of the demo. With a huge graphics overhaul, with limited performance impact :
[list]

Known issues:

[*] Sometimes the game crashes when a mission is completed (successfully or failed). Still trying to reproduce the exact cause of this.

[*] The physics of the cubes at the start of the game is a lot worse than the cubes in the missions.
[*] There is no way to skip a cutscene (annoying when replaying a level, trust me I know :-) )
[*] A lot of information is only in audio voice lines. 
[*] Minimum spec is CPU bound, this causes the game to run slower. This will be improved, but not in the sort term.
[*] Index controllers need to be reoriented in the medical bay.
[*] Game progress is saved only per finished mission. 
[*] If you restart the game all settings have been reset.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest V47 : Settings, Mission select and Story remade
notes.content:
There is a new version (47) of the Free Open Playtest. After months without a new version there is light at the end of the tunnel. 

When starting the game you will find yourself aboard a spaceship where a hovering droid will explain the situation you are in. This droid will also give you information about all the systems on the ship. You can move around on something resembling a standing wheelchair.

Currently you can 
- Change the controller orientation and offset
- Change the renderscale (FSR amount, affects GPU performance and visuals)
- Enable/Disable PostProcessing (affects GPU performance and visuals)

Just like in the older versions you can
- Change the table height, this is also the terrain floor height in game.
- Reset the game progress (start over)

What's next :
- The wheelchair movement will be incorporated into the fighting part of the game
- Some settings in the fighting part of the game will be made available
- The information from the droid will be improved in the menu part of the game


Known issues :
- The second mission is too hard. 
- Throw distance is generally too far. 
- Lasers don't have the right color.  

Roadmap:
- Improve level balance 
- Add very easy first level (defense only)
- Have a near 'final production' DEMO version ready for Strategy Fest 2023.
